name: 会話の呼びかけと反応の受信一覧
prompt:
Edit reference image 1 (the current 390×800 Japanese activity screen) using reference image 2 as the exact content/geometry guide. Reference image 3 is the original screen, image 4 the exact profile icon, and image 5 the exact male portrait. This is the second and final pass; fix the specific mismatches below while preserving the source-matching filter icons, original portraits, blue links, neutral no-tint surfaces, green brand header, active filter, wording and typography.

Exact native bounds: solid green header y0–132; title x16 y12; profile icon x334 y14 36×36; white search field x16 y66 358×40; filter tabs y150 h32 at x16/88/210/312 with widths 62/112/92/62. First card top y206, divider y344; second card top y368, divider y506; reaction card top y530, divider y716; unread button x282 y748 92×32.

First card: @ icon and text header at y214 with 1時間前 on right. Male source portrait at x16 y248 exactly 36×36. Name 山田 はるか at x64 y243; reply line at x64 y273; body こちらもすてきです！ 佐藤さん at x64 y304. Second card: thread-bubble header at y376 with 1時間前; female source portrait at x16 y410 exactly 36×36 (use the female photo shown in reference image 3); name at x64 y405; reply line at x64 y435; body at x64 y466. In both body lines only 佐藤さん is blue. Header text must use the Japanese middle dot: 呼びかけ・交流のアイデア, with only 交流のアイデア blue.

Reaction card: the heading at x16 y538 is exactly 山田さんと佐藤さんが「交流のアイデア」で反応, with only 交流のアイデア blue and no timestamp. Do not place any icon in the heading. At x20.7 y579.9 place the source solid red heart 22.5×19.1. There is no avatar photo in this card. Place 田中 あおい at x64 y572, then the two body lines at x64 y604. Place the 👍 賛同 1 and ❤️ ハート 1 neutral-gray chips at x64 y670 size86×32 and x160 y670 size102×32. Do not add a third portrait or any extra time label.

Keep the blue links #1976D2 without underlines. Keep white row surfaces, neutral gray borders/fills for inactive tabs, search, unread control and reaction chips; no mint or pastel tints. Preserve the solid green selected すべて filter and the original green online dot. Keep source @, chat-bubble, smile-plus, search and reaction glyph silhouettes. Do not shift content between rows, add source-only text, gradients, shadows or other elements. Return exactly 390×800px.
reviewNotes: The reaction card now has no extra portrait or timestamp and places the solid red heart beside the name. reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
